title: Tenant-Isolated Agent Memory
signature: class MemoryStore: write(ctx, key, value, scope='private', sources=()), read(ctx, key), visible(ctx), delete_user(tenant, user)
hints: Write one visibility predicate and use it everywhere: read, visible and the source check on write. The tenant check comes first, for every scope.
The upsert identity is (tenant, user, agent, key). User ids and team names repeat across tenants, so never key anything on them alone.
Deletion is a graph walk: start from the user's own memories, then keep adding any memory whose sources include a deleted one until nothing changes.
